Keep the upper quarter calm and dark with no objects, ready for one short line of typography to be composited later. Use realistic ceramic, coffee and pastry textures and source-faithful colors; the finished creative should feel bold, simple and commercially useful at a 144px-wide preview. This is a fictional demonstration creative, not a live merchant offer. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, prices, discounts, watermarks, social chrome or UI.
